'''The Yearly Brawl''' is an [[inn]] in [[Ebou Dar]], owned and operated by the innkeeper [[Kathana]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Yearly Brawl, The}}  Kathana is married to a [[Seanchan]] immigrant named [[Jame]] who serves as the establishment's primary bouncer. The inn's sign features an image of people clapping.


[[Mat Cauthon]] stops at The Yearly Brawl, thinking it is his type of inn. He learns from [[Jame]], the bouncer and husband of the innkeeper [[Kathana]], that [[Tuon]] is under threat of assassins.{{ref/book|14|11}}


==Background==
Jame and Kathana are named for James and Jennifer Liang, two high-profile moderators at [http://dragonmount.com Dragonmount.com] and coordinators of [[JordanCon]].
